description: Reports whether a channel played (ok=true) or not (ok=false with code). The browser and the system come from the User-Agent, and the country comes from the request data; the body cannot change them. The first report of a result on a day returns 201. It counts once per owner, channel, day and result; a repeat returns 200 with `reason: ja_relatado_hoje`. The reports help to compare results in `GET /api/channels/:id/health`, but they do not confirm the cause of a failure.

channel_id.description: The channel that you tried to watch.

code.description: Failure code, only when `ok` is `false`. A missing or unknown code counts as `outro`.

ok.description: `true` when it played, `false` when it failed.

name: report_play
title: Report a play
